firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose the starting player. Beginning with that player, go around the table choosing cat figures and placing them on the island in turn order.
clarifications: The initial starting player draws the first day’s cat tiles. Before rescuing cats, players reveal their Rescue cards and reorder their cat figures by speed; the fastest rescues first.
Tied speeds keep the tied players’ relative order.
In the family game, choose the initial starting player randomly too. That player draws the tiles and chooses first; move their cat figure to the end of the order after each day.
